svg.title: Homologous chromosome pairing with an inversion
svg.desc: Two chromosome ribbons show reversed gene-for-gene attraction within an inverted interval, then a physical pairing loop. This overview does not depict four chromatids or crossing over.
svg.metadata: Original editable schematic, created 2026-11-10. Source facts: genetics/LECT13/djot/assets/lect13b-chromo_alter_3-inversion/image_003.png; original ODP slides 6, 10, 12, 14, 16. Geometry newly composed, not traced. Unmeasured. Source labels and stage/copy counts preserved.
